data.summary: Musterquell Krankenkasse informs Johanna Beispielacker that her monthly contributions for statutory health and long-term care insurance (voluntarily insured) will rise to €318.46 from 1 January 2027, due to a new supplementary contribution rate and her income per the 2025 tax assessment.
data.explanation: Your Krankenkasse is raising your monthly contribution to €318.46 starting 1 January 2027, because of a higher supplementary contribution rate and your reported 2025 income. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) if you disagree with the assessment; the app shows the deadline for this. A price increase like this may also give you a special right to end your membership arrangement early — the app will show until when you may decide. No other action is needed if you accept the new amount; it will simply be collected as before.
data.tax_note: Contributions to statutory health and long-term care insurance are deductible as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in the annual tax return.
